package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type mutationSummaryState struct {
	scope       domain.TeacherContextScope
	from        int64
	through     int64
	invalidated bool
}

type contextMutationStore struct {
	receipts  map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation
	fences    map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation
	summaries []*mutationSummaryState
	err       error
}

func (store *contextMutationStore) ApplyMutation(_ context.Context, raw domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation, _ time.Time) (repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult, error) {
	if store.err != nil {
		return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{}, store.err
	}
	mutation, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherContextMutation(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{}, err
	}
	if existing, found := store.receipts[mutation.EventID]; found {
		if existing != mutation {
			return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{}, domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict
		}
		return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{}, nil
	}
	store.receipts[mutation.EventID] = mutation
	key := mutation.StudentID + mutation.PersonalTeacherID + mutation.DialogID + string(mutation.ContextType) + mutation.ContextID + mutation.MessageID
	if existing, found := store.fences[key]; found {
		if existing.MessageSequence != mutation.MessageSequence ||
			(existing.MessageVersion == mutation.MessageVersion && (existing.LastEventSequence != mutation.LastEventSequence || existing.Mutation != mutation.Mutation)) ||
			(existing.MessageVersion < mutation.MessageVersion && existing.LastEventSequence >= mutation.LastEventSequence) {
			return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{}, domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict
		}
		if existing.MessageVersion >= mutation.MessageVersion {
			return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{Processed: true}, nil
		}
	}
	store.fences[key] = mutation
	invalidated := false
	for _, summary := range store.summaries {
		if summary.scope == mutation.Scope() && !summary.invalidated && summary.from <= mutation.MessageSequence && summary.through >= mutation.MessageSequence {
			summary.invalidated = true
			invalidated = true
		}
	}
	return repository.TeacherContextMutationApplyResult{Processed: true, Advanced: true, Invalidated: invalidated}, nil
}

func mutationFixture(eventID string, version int, eventSequence int64) domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation {
	return domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{
		SchemaVersion: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutatedSchemaVersion,
		EventID:       eventID, EventType: domain.SubjectDialogTeacherContextMutated,
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		DialogID:   "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", EventSequence: eventSequence,
		StudentID:         "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		PersonalTeacherID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		MessageID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", MessageSequence: 7,
		MessageVersion: version, LastEventSequence: eventSequence, Mutation: domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationUpdated,
	}
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerInvalidatesCompactedRangeWithoutHistory(t *testing.T) {
	mutation := mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 2, 61)
	summary := &mutationSummaryState{scope: mutation.Scope(), from: 1, through: 20}
	store := &contextMutationStore{receipts: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, fences: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, summaries: []*mutationSummaryState{summary}}
	handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)}}

	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutation)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.True(t, summary.invalidated)

	processed, err = handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutation)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, processed)
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerInvalidatesCompactedRangeAfterDelete(t *testing.T) {
	mutation := mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 2, 61)
	mutation.Mutation = domain.DialogTeacherContextMutationDeleted
	summary := &mutationSummaryState{scope: mutation.Scope(), from: 1, through: 20}
	store := &contextMutationStore{receipts: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, fences: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, summaries: []*mutationSummaryState{summary}}
	handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)}}

	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutation)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.True(t, summary.invalidated)
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerIgnoresReorderedOlderVersionAfterRebuild(t *testing.T) {
	newer := mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 3, 62)
	summary := &mutationSummaryState{scope: newer.Scope(), from: 1, through: 20}
	store := &contextMutationStore{receipts: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, fences: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, summaries: []*mutationSummaryState{summary}}
	handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Now().UTC()}}

	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), newer)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.True(t, summary.invalidated)

	// Simulate a safe rebuild from the current Dialog state. A reordered older
	// event is durably receipted but cannot advance the fence or invalidate it.
	summary.invalidated = false
	older := mutationFixture("77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", 2, 61)
	processed, err = handler.Handle(context.Background(), older)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.False(t, summary.invalidated)
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerLeavesOutsideRangeAndCrossBindingSummariesIntact(t *testing.T) {
	base := mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 2, 61)
	tests := map[string]func(*domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation){
		"outside range": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.MessageID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
			value.MessageSequence = 21
		},
		"student binding": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.StudentID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
		},
		"dialog binding": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.DialogID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
		},
		"teacher binding": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.PersonalTeacherID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
		},
		"context binding": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.ContextID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
		},
		"context type binding": func(value *domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation) {
			value.ContextType = domain.LearningContextPracticeTask
		},
	}
	for name, mutate := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			summary := &mutationSummaryState{scope: base.Scope(), from: 1, through: 20}
			store := &contextMutationStore{receipts: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, fences: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}, summaries: []*mutationSummaryState{summary}}
			handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Now().UTC()}}
			mutation := base
			mutate(&mutation)
			processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutation)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.True(t, processed)
			require.False(t, summary.invalidated)
		})
	}
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerPropagatesTransactionalFailure(t *testing.T) {
	store := &contextMutationStore{err: errors.New("transaction failed")}
	handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Now().UTC()}}
	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 2, 61))
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "transaction failed")
	require.False(t, processed)
}

func TestContextMutationHandlerRejectsConflictingEventReplay(t *testing.T) {
	mutation := mutationFixture("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", 2, 61)
	store := &contextMutationStore{receipts: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{mutation.EventID: mutation}, fences: map[string]domain.DialogTeacherContextMutation{}}
	handler := teacherdialog.ContextMutationHandler{Mutations: store, Clock: dialogClock{value: time.Now().UTC()}}
	mutation.MessageVersion = 3
	_, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), mutation)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrDialogTeacherContextMutationConflict)
}
